conditions.description: The cursor moved to a different position. Some text was typed, edited or deleted. A menu, dropdown, dialog or panel opened or closed. The page or view scrolled. An element was highlighted, selected or hovered. The zoom level changed.

The mouse cursor moved to a new position and now hovers over a different element, which is highlighted. Text in a field or editor was typed, edited, selected or deleted, and the text cursor moved. A menu, dropdown, context menu, tooltip, popup, dialog, sidebar or panel appeared or disappeared. The page, list or document scrolled, so different content is visible. A button, tab, checkbox or item was clicked, selected or toggled and its color or outline changed. A new tab, window or page opened, or the view switched to another page. The zoom level, window size or layout changed. Numbers, labels, a status indicator, a timestamp or a progress indicator changed. An image, icon or video frame changed. Everything else stays the same.
